glosses: shop, store (establishment that sells goods or services to the public; originally only a physical location, but now a virtual establishment as well)
any establishment entertaining guests, especially a pub or bar, but also a hotel, restaurant, discotheque, etc.
a (usually organised) group of people and its affairs: a company, political party, club, school, etc.

examples.text: Wo kann ich mein Handy laden?
examples.en: Where can I charge my phone?
I want to go to the store.

examples.text: Hier gibt es viele kleine Läden.
examples.en: There are a lot of small shops in this area.
